name: Dead Head Girl
source:
Ah, the wonders of young love. Wren has it all - a distant mother, absolutely no prospects, and the ability to spit up large amount of rotting blood. 

That last one hurts, actually. Quite a bit, and the only cure is confessing, to one of two girls:

Katriel, her old friend from middle school who doesn't speak to her anymore, or Ines, a dreamy artist who seems more interested in her work than the world. 

Can Wren find true love? (No. No she cannot.) 

[From [url=https://laundrylich.itch.io/dead-head-girl]itch.io[/url]]
